summary: To use the templating, create an Organization, Team or Role map with an Attributes trigger, put the template in the name field and the attribute name in Attribute; typos raise a validation error and missing attributes are logged in platform gateway.
questions: How do I set up a dynamic organization map?
Why was my templated authenticator map rejected?
What happens if the IdP doesn't return the templated attribute?

answer_card.title: Dynamic org map from an IdP attribute
answer_card.answer_md:
Access Management > Authentication Methods > your authenticator > **Mapping > Create mapping**:
- Authentication mapping: *Organization* (or Team, Role)
- Trigger: *Attributes*
- Organization: `Org {% for_attr_value(users_orgs) %}`
- Attribute: `users_orgs`

If the IdP returns `["Database", "Networking"]`, the map runs for `Org Database` and `Org Networking`.
